newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK prosperity a matter of Chinese pride - Tsang.
newsitem.headline: HK prosperity a matter of Chinese pride - Tsang.

text.p: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said that maintaining Hong Kong's prosperity was a matter of national pride for China.
Speaking to Reuters in an interview on Wednesday, Tsang said "Hong Kong as a prosperous economic centre is a matter of great national honour for China".
Tsang said he believed many people underestimate how important the return of Hong Kong and its continued prosperity are for China.

"Some foreign commentators see (China) as a threat coming from the point of view that China is practising socialism and therefore it will not be able to allow Hong Kong to continue along this way of life for long," he said.
Tsang said he believed this was a misconception that would be proven wrong by Hong Kong's continued prosperity after the transition to Chinese rule on July 1.
"We will continue to be prosperous, the stock market will continue to be strong, all the economic indicators are robust," he said.
Tsang, who will remain in his position after the handover, said he was setting his course to make Hong Kong the number one international financial centre in East Asia.
"We will just continue on our course, making sure we reach our destination," he said.
